body.name: v17.0.1
body.message:
[v17.0/forgejo] ci: only run current forgejo version end-to-end tests (#15040)

**Backport:** https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15036

Only run the version specific end-to-end tests for the current release stream. this saves ci time and stops breaking other release builds failing on e2e

also needs https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/end-to-end/pulls/2592

Reviewed-on: https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15040
